entities.name: Gwendoline Eastlake-Smith

entities.summary: Gladys Shirley Eastlake Smith, also known as Gwendoline Eastlake-Smith and Gladys Lamplough, was a British tennis player. She won an Olympic gold medal at the 1908 Summer Olympics in London.
